headline: AI selloff deepens on rate-hike fears; Brewers one win from the World Series
backdrop: Wednesday was the worst day since July (S&P 500 −1.11% to 7,718.94, Nasdaq −1.88%) after hot September CPI. CME FedWatch: 27% odds of an October hike, 67% for December. 10-yr yield near 5%.

finance.why: Hot CPI + rising hike odds; Nasdaq futures fell >1% pre-open as the AI rout spread.
finance.risk: PPI/retail sales soft print could spark a short-covering bounce.

finance.label: CRWV
finance.why: Debt-heavy AI infra is ground zero: −15% Wednesday, CDS widening on CoreWeave, Oracle, SoftBank.

finance.label: AVGO
finance.why: J.P. Morgan top pick: supply, not demand, gates growth, so expect beat-and-raise into Q3.
finance.risk: JPM strategists warn this rebound won't be as fast as July's.
